TileStructure.Forest.density_tree_bound2.statement: (Lemma 7.3.1, second part) Let $X$ be a metric space, and assume the standing assumptions of the proof: the data $a \in \mathbb{N}$, $q \in \mathbb{R}$, $K : X \times X \to \mathbb{C}$, $\sigma_1, \sigma_2 : X \to \mathbb{Z}$, $F, G \subseteq X$ satisfy `ProofData` (so that $X$ is a doubling metric measure space with measure `volume`), and $X$ carries a tile structure (`TileStructure` with $Q$, $D$ = `defaultD a`, $\kappa$ = `defaultκ a`, $S$ = `defaultS X` and the point `cancelPt X`), with tiles $\mathfrak{P}(X)$ and dyadic grid cubes. Let $f,g : X \to \mathbb{C}$ be bounded with compact support, with $\operatorname{supp} f\subseteq F$ and $\operatorname{supp} g\subseteq G$, and let $n \in \mathbb{N}$, let $t$ be an $n$-forest and $u\in t$. Then $$\Big\|\int_X\overline{g(x)}\,T_{\mathfrak T(u)}f(x)\,dx\Big\|\le C_{7.3.1.2}(a)\,\mathrm{dens}_1(\mathfrak T(u))^{1/2}\,\mathrm{dens}_2(\mathfrak T(u))^{1/2}\,\|f\|_{L^2}\,\|g\|_{L^2}.$$

TileStructure.Forest.density_tree_bound1.statement: (Lemma 7.3.1, first part) Let $X$ be a metric space, and assume the standing assumptions of the proof: the data $a \in \mathbb{N}$, $q \in \mathbb{R}$, $K : X \times X \to \mathbb{C}$, $\sigma_1, \sigma_2 : X \to \mathbb{Z}$, $F, G \subseteq X$ satisfy `ProofData` (so that $X$ is a doubling metric measure space with measure `volume`), and $X$ carries a tile structure (`TileStructure` with $Q$, $D$ = `defaultD a`, $\kappa$ = `defaultκ a`, $S$ = `defaultS X` and the point `cancelPt X`), with tiles $\mathfrak{P}(X)$ and dyadic grid cubes. Let $f,g : X \to \mathbb{C}$ be bounded with compact support, with $\operatorname{supp} g\subseteq G$, and let $n \in \mathbb{N}$, let $t$ be an $n$-forest and $u\in t$. Then $$\Big\|\int_X\overline{g(x)}\,T_{\mathfrak T(u)}f(x)\,dx\Big\|\le C_{7.3.1.1}(a)\,\mathrm{dens}_1(\mathfrak T(u))^{1/2}\,\|f\|_{L^2}\,\|g\|_{L^2}.$$

TileStructure.Forest.local_dens1_tree_bo.statement: (Lemma 7.3.2) Let $X$ be a metric space, and assume the standing assumptions of the proof: the data $a \in \mathbb{N}$, $q \in \mathbb{R}$, $K : X \times X \to \mathbb{C}$, $\sigma_1, \sigma_2 : X \to \mathbb{Z}$, $F, G \subseteq X$ satisfy `ProofData` (so that $X$ is a doubling metric measure space with measure `volume`), and $X$ carries a tile structure (`TileStructure` with $Q$, $D$ = `defaultD a`, $\kappa$ = `defaultκ a`, $S$ = `defaultS X` and the point `cancelPt X`), with tiles $\mathfrak{P}(X)$ and dyadic grid cubes. Let $n \in \mathbb{N}$, let $t$ be an $n$-forest, $u\in t$ and $L\in\mathcal L(\mathfrak T(u))$. Then $$\mu\Big(L\cap G\cap\bigcup_{\mathfrak p\in\mathfrak T(u)}E(\mathfrak p)\Big)\le C_{7.3.2}(a)\,\mathrm{dens}_1(\mathfrak T(u))\,\mu(L).$$
